preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2*10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Length of each permutation is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p) for p in ps)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n for p in ps)

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= n*(n-1)//2 for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer not exceeding the maximum possible number of inversions.
